    # Validate inputs

        if arr.size == 0:

        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
    # Check consistent shape
    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != (n_candidates, future_horizon):
        raise ValueError("Input shapes do not match")
    if logp_no_call.shape != (n_candidates, future_horizon):
        raise ValueError("Input shapes do not match")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    # Compute decreasing future-token weights (T01)

    weights = raw_weights / weight_sum  # normalized, shape (future_horizon,)

    # Compute weighted sums per candidate (dot product over last axis)
    weighted_with = logp_with_result @ weights  # shape (n_candidates,)
    weighted_call = logp_call_only @ weights
    weighted_no = logp_no_call @ weights

    # Compute margins: reduction in loss when using call with result
    # Loss = -logp, so reduction = loss_no_call - loss_with_result
    # = -weighted_no - (-weighted_with) = weighted_with - weighted_no
    margins = weighted_with - weighted_no

    # Keep condition: margin > tau and call-only not much worse than no-call
